S=os.path.expanduser('~/.factory/sessions/-Users-dct-code-EllyaOrg-projects-dalimaray-droid-observatory/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c.jsonl')
def T(s): return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00')).timestamp()
msgs=[]
for l in open(S):
    try:o=json.loads(l)
    except: continue
    if o.get('type')!='message' or o['message'].get('role')!='assistant': continue
    c=o['message'].get('content') or []
    tools=[(x.get('name'),json.dumps(x.get('input'))) for x in c if x.get('type')=='tool_use']
    text=sum(len(x.get('text','')) for x in c if x.get('type')=='text')
    msgs.append(dict(ts=o['timestamp'],t=T(o['timestamp']),tools=tools,text=text))
turns=json.load(open('/tmp/m3int/orch_turns.json'))
FROM='2026-10-24T04:27:53'
WRITE=re.compile(r'(missions/e194b9e3[^"]*\.(md|json|jsonl|yaml)|features\.json|validation-state|AGENTS\.md|library/)')
def cls(m):
    names=[n for n,_ in m['tools']]
    if names and all(n=='WaitForScript' for n in names): return 'waits'
    dec={'Edit','Create','StartMissionRun','DismissHandoffItems','Task','TaskStop'}
    if any(n in dec for n in names): return 'decisions'
    for n,i in m['tools']:
        if n in('Script','Execute') and WRITE.search(i) and re.search(r'(>\s*[~/$"\\]|tee |\bmv |\bcp |sed -i|jq[^|]*>|open\(.*[\'"]w)',i): return 'decisions'
    if m['text'] and not names: return 'decisions'
    if m['text']: return 'decisions'
    return 'narration'
import bisect
ts=[m['t'] for m in msgs]
res=collections.defaultdict(lambda:collections.Counter())
unmatched=0;maxd=0
rows=[]
for t in turns:
    if t['ts']<FROM: continue
    tt=T(t['ts'])
    k=bisect.bisect_left(ts,tt-3)
    best=None
    for j in range(max(0,k-2),min(len(msgs),k+6)):
        d=abs(msgs[j]['t']-tt)
        if d<=3 and (best is None or d<best[0]): best=(d,j)
    if not best: unmatched+=1; c='unmatched'
    else: c=cls(msgs[best[1]]); maxd=max(maxd,best[0])
    key=(c,'kimi' if t['m']!='claude-fable-5.1' else 'fable')
    for f in 'i','o','cr','cw': res[key][f]+=t[f]
    res[key]['n']+=1
print('unmatched',unmatched,'maxd',round(maxd,3))
P=dict(i=10.0,o=50.0,cr=0.25,cw=12.5)
tot=0
for k in sorted(res):
    v=res[k]; usd=sum(v[f]*P[f]/1e6 for f in P)
    if k[1]=='fable': tot+=usd
    print(k,dict(v),round(usd,2))
print('fable total',round(tot,2))
EOF
